# timbre observation result

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:timbreObservationResult`](gmeow-timbreObservationResult.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/timbreObservationResult>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/music`](../../slices/music.md)
- **Box roles:** [RBox role](../boxes/rbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

The timbre descriptor assigned to an observed [`ToneEvent`](../classes/gmeow-ToneEvent.md) by this [`Observation`](../classes/gmeow-Observation.md). Semantically plays the [`gmeow:observationResult`](gmeow-observationResult.md) role, but it is NOT declared [rdfs:subPropertyOf](http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#subPropertyOf) [`gmeow:observationResult`](gmeow-observationResult.md) because [`gmeow:TimbreDescriptor`](../classes/gmeow-TimbreDescriptor.md) is a [gufo:QualityValue](../../external/terms.md#gufo-qualityvalue) (abstract individual) and therefore disjoint from [`gmeow:Entity`](../classes/gmeow-Entity.md), the range of [`gmeow:observationResult`](gmeow-observationResult.md) (the [`claimModality`](gmeow-claimModality.md) precedent, standpoint and norms modules).
